remarks: Welcome to 3203 36 Street NW, Edmonton, AB T6L 4N5! Discover this spacious and versatile family home offering 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a fully finished basement, and an attached double garage.  The thoughtfully designed main floor features a bright and inviting living room, a dedicated dining area, a functional kitchen, a cozy family room, and a versatile den, providing plenty of space for comfortable everyday living. An additional bonus room offers even more flexibility for entertaining, relaxing, or family activities. The fully finished basement with a separate entrance provides excellent potential for extended family living, guests, or additional recreational space. Situated on a desirable corner lot of approximately 5,200 sq. ft., this property offers a fantastic combination of space, functionality, and convenience. Located in a peaceful cul-de-sac, with shopping, schools, parks, and everyday amenities nearby, this home is an excellent opportunity for growing families. (id:67522)
